h: Binder: every page now the same A4 size

i.x: Every page in a generated binder is now placed on its own A4 portrait sheet, scaled to fit and centred, so Chain Laws and the other documents no longer come out bigger or smaller than the rest. Chain Laws, Maximum Weight Rule and ELD Manual were also added to the binder order.

Company Documents are now converted to A4 automatically when uploaded (images become an A4 PDF) and download as A4. The binder warning also reminds you to add the Truck Lease Agreement and the KY, NM, NY and OR permits.

h: New: Generate A Binder on every truck

i.x: Open a truck and click the new book icon (between Files & Media and the eraser). A draggable window lists the binder documents in order; drag to reorder, untick to leave one out, then Generate to download one merged PDF. The truck number is written on the Binder Main Page, the latest Cab Card and DOT inspection come from the truck files, landscape forms are turned to fit A4, and you get a warning before continuing if anything is expired or expires within 10 days.

h: Kansas form: address split above Street, City, State and Zip

h: New York, Washington and Kansas forms: left-aligned, correct fields

i.x: The vendor and company details on the New York, Washington and Kansas forms are left-aligned and go in the right boxes (seller details no longer get our own address). EIN and USDOT are filled where the form has a spot for them.
Removed the "Claude is looking for the missing details" message from the fill window.

h: Tax exempt forms: download a blank copy

i.x: New download arrow next to the trash can on each tax exempt form. It saves a clean, blank copy of that form with nothing filled in.

h: Connecticut form added

h: Nebraska form: city, state and ZIP line up under their labels

i.x: On the Nebraska form the state and ZIP now start under their labels, and the check mark sits centered in its box.

h: Nebraska form: black text, same font, lifted above the lines

i.x: Nebraska form text is black, one font size, and sits above its lines. Upload the form named 08_Nebraska_Form13.pdf so the app recognises it.

h: South Carolina form: more space above the seller name line

i.x: The vendor name now sits a little higher above its line, with the same spacing as the address row.

h: Tax exempt forms: warning when a form already exists

i.x: Uploading a form for a state that is already in the list (or with the same name) now stops and asks before adding it, with Add anyway or Cancel.

h: South Carolina form: filled text same size

i.x: The vendor name, address and date on the South Carolina form now use the same font size as the rest of the form. Upload the form named 04_South_Carolina_ST8A.pdf so the app recognises it.

h: Utah form: removed FAA and Dealer number boxes from the editor

i.x: The FAA certificate and Dealer number boxes no longer show in the fill-in window; those fields stay blank on the form.

h: Utah form: seller info left-aligned

i.x: Seller/lessor name, dealer number and seller address now start at the left instead of being centered.

h: Pennsylvania form: seller info left-aligned with the labels

i.x: Seller name, street, city, state, ZIP and the date now start at the left, lined up with the wording above them.

h: New Jersey form: purchaser info left-aligned, Owner sits on the Title line

i.x: Name of purchaser, address and type of business are now left-aligned, and the Owner text sits right above the Title line.

h: Pennsylvania form: filled date matches the other text

i.x: On forms with fill-in fields the filled text now keeps the colour the form uses for that field and uses one common size, so on the Pennsylvania form the date is the same size and colour as the name and address instead of being huge.

h: Tax exempt forms: text already in the PDF matches the filled text

i.x: On forms with fill-in fields (New Jersey, Utah and others) the text that is already printed in the PDF, such as the purchaser address, is now shown in the same size, colour and alignment as the text the app fills in, so the name, address and type of business line up as one set.

h: New Jersey form: address split above its labels, normal description size

i.x: New Jersey ST-4: the seller address is split into street, city, state and zip and written above Address, City, State and ZIP Code, in a normal size. The long exempt purpose box is no longer filled in huge letters, and long text boxes no longer shrink the size of the other fields.

h: Tax exempt forms: filled fields centred

i.x: On forms with fill-in fields (Georgia, Utah and others) the filled text, such as the EIN and phone number, is now centred horizontally and vertically in its box and sized to fit the box height, so it no longer sits on the line.

h: Tax exempt form: Delete button readable on hover

i.x: In the tax exempt form window the Delete button turned solid red on hover and its label disappeared. It now turns red with a white label and icon.

h: Upload documents: type dates directly, with a calendar button

i.x: In Upload documents the Start and Expires boxes are normal text boxes: type 11102026 or 11/10/2026 and the slashes are added for you. A calendar button next to each box still opens the date picker.

h: Tax exempt forms: black text, even font size

i.x: Forms that have fill-in fields (like Utah TC-719) are now filled in black with one common font size for every field, instead of blue text that changed size from field to field.

h: Home: smaller Contact Information and Tax Exempt Forms boxes

i.x: On the Home page the Company Details and Company Documents boxes now take 60% of the height, and the Contact Information and Tax Exempt Forms boxes below them take 40%.

h: Wisconsin form: seller name and address centred in their boxes

i.x: On the Wisconsin form the seller name and address are now centred vertically in the space under their labels instead of sitting low in the box.

h: Wisconsin tax exempt form layout

i.x: Wisconsin form: the vendor name is written under the Seller's Name label, the vendor address under Seller's Address (with a box to type it), and the date on page 2 now has the same size and line as the printed name and title. The form is also recognised when its file name has extra words in front of the number.

h: Tax exempt forms: pasted addresses split correctly for everyone

i.x: Pasting a vendor address copied from Google (for example ending in ", USA") now splits into street, city, state and zip right away, as soon as it is pasted, instead of only when it is exactly in one format and you click out of the box.

h: Tax exempt forms open instantly for everyone

i.x: After signing in, every computer quietly downloads the tax exempt forms in the background and keeps them, so a form opens right away when clicked, the same as the company documents.

h: Tax exempt forms: repaired in the cloud, faster failure

i.x: Some tax exempt forms had a cloud entry but the file itself was missing from cloud storage, so other people could not open them. After the office computer signs in, it now checks every tax form and re-uploads any file the cloud lost. A form that cannot be opened now says so quickly instead of retrying the same missing file twice.

h: Tax exempt forms are stored online and open for everyone

i.x: Tax exempt forms now look in the cloud directly when this computer has no copy, and when a form cannot be opened the message says exactly why (never saved to the cloud, storage refused it, not connected). Forms are stored online, not on one computer: new forms go to the cloud when added (even if this computer's storage is full), and forms that only exist on the office computer are uploaded automatically after sign-in.

h: FMCSA refresh now sticks

i.x: The FMCSA dates (Data as of, Updated, Next) and the inspection, crash and vehicle counts were fetched but not shown when the app was still loading your saved data. The refresh now writes to the current data after it finishes.

h: FMCSA sign-in also refreshes the dates and counts

i.x: After you sign in to FMCSA SMS and the percentiles are read, the app now also refreshes the Data as of, Updated and Next dates and the inspection, crash and vehicle counts, so the whole line updates together.

h: Citations: no OOS / court contact; inspection copy without points

i.x: Citations: the OOS column, the Out of Service line in the summary and the Out of service tile are removed. New and edited citations no longer have the Out of Service box (also in Add another citation) or the Court contact box. Inspections: holding a row to copy it no longer includes the Points cell.

h: Cab cards: use the year in the file name

i.x: When a cab card is dropped and its file name has the expiry year (for example Registration 2027) but the card text was read as another year, the Upload documents window now uses the year from the file name (start year one earlier), so it is no longer reported as a duplicate of last year's card. You can still change the dates by hand.

h: Upload documents: type dates by hand

i.x: In the Upload documents window you can now type the Start and Expires dates yourself (the calendar still works). Before, the window refreshed after the first digit of the year and wiped what you were typing.

h: Files & Media: no more storage-full error

i.x: Adding many files (for example Registration PDFs) to equipment Files & Media no longer fails with "exceeded the quota". The app first frees space on this computer for files already safe in the cloud; if that is still not enough, it uploads the new files to the cloud directly and tells you to keep the app open until it shows Synced.

h: FMCSA sign-in rebuilt

i.x: The Sign in to SMS flow was rewritten from scratch (needs the new desktop installer): the sign-in window opens attached to the app, shows an error with Try again if FMCSA cannot be reached instead of a blank page, can only be opened once at a time, and a failure can no longer take the app down. The Home screen shows what is happening and reads your percentiles when you close the window.

h: FMCSA SMS: monthly update reminder

i.x: The app now remembers which month of FMCSA data your percentiles came from. When FMCSA publishes new data (the Next week of date), the Sign in to SMS link turns into a red "New month: sign in to update my %" so you know it is time, and it clears itself once the percentiles are loaded. If your SMS login is still active the app updates them silently every few hours, as before.

h: Inspection driver name follows your HR list

i.x: In inspections and citations, the driver name from the AI scan or a paste is matched to your HR list and written exactly as saved there (no middle names, same spelling, First Last). If the driver is not in HR it still flips LAST FIRST to First Last as before.

h: AI chat: no more empty "Done." answers

i.x: When the AI ended a turn without an answer (so the chat just said Done.), the app now asks it again automatically, up to twice, so you do not have to retype your request. Redeploy worker.js as well: it now lets the AI write longer answers and files (8000 instead of 3000).

h: Edit invoices: selection follows the filter

i.x: In Edit invoices, changing the vendor filter or the search now deselects invoices that are no longer shown, so only what you can see can be selected (and deleted).

h: Toll notes shortened

i.x: Toll invoice notes are now short, for example 09/25/2026 @ 01:16:39 TX, read automatically from the long Ryder text (new uploads and invoices already saved).

h: Invoice upload message: short, with an X

i.x: After uploading many invoices, the message is now one short line (for example 3 invoices added. 62 already added, skipped.) with an X to dismiss it, instead of a huge red block. The duplicate pop-up only appears for up to 3 duplicates.

h: Contract & Rental invoices: Lease / Rental lines

i.x: Contract and rental charges stay together as one "Contract & Rental" invoice type (type filter, upload window, invoice picker, which now always shows the type next to the invoice number). In the table, each line is labelled Lease or Rental in the TYPE column, including invoices already saved and every new upload.

h: Invoice upload: progress bar, no flicker

i.x: Uploading several invoices now shows one progress bar (0 to 100%) at the top of the Invoices window. The window no longer redraws or jumps to each invoice while reading, and it stays on whatever you were viewing. When the batch finishes it shows how many were added.

h: Add invoice: file count, remove file, auto names

i.x: The Add invoice window shows how many files were dropped, for example (70 files), and each file has an X to remove it before adding.

Copies such as "XD3398 (2)" no longer show the (2), and after the invoice is read the saved file is named from the invoice number (for example Ryder Invoice YL4785.pdf) unless you typed your own name.

h: Invoices: dropped files cleared on close

i.x: Closing the Invoices or Disputes window now throws away any dropped or selected files and open Add invoice window, so reopening starts clean.

h: Add invoice window fits many files

i.x: Dropping many invoices (for example 70) no longer makes the Add invoice window taller than the screen: the file name list is compact and scrolls, and the buttons stay visible. All Invoices & Disputes windows now also stay within the screen height and scroll when needed.

h: Ryder invoices: tax charges now read

i.x: Contract & Rental invoices now read the Taxes section of each vehicle page (for example AZ 5% Surcharge, AZ Privilege Tax credit, Total taxes). The amount shows in a new TAX column, the tax lines show in Notes, and the TAX column is in print/Excel. Invoices uploaded earlier need to be uploaded again to pick this up.

h: AI chats: date and time on every message

i.x: Every message in all AI chats (Work Orders, Invoices & Disputes, Maintenance Reports) now shows the date and time it was sent, and the Thinking… bubble shows how many seconds it has been working.

h: AI: clearer connection error and one retry

i.x: When the AI cannot be reached, the app now retries once automatically and, if it still fails, says that it could not reach the AI service (instead of just Failed to fetch).

h: Invoice notes: PCS higher wording

i.x: Invoices: whenever the PCS odometer is higher than the invoice ending odometer, the note now reads exactly "PCS odometer is higher than invoice ending odometer" (in the table and the line window). The "Minimum mileage?" note is removed everywhere.

h: Invoice status from PCS odometer

i.x: Invoices: a PCS odometer lower than the invoice ending odometer now sets the status to Issue automatically. A PCS odometer higher than the invoice ending odometer no longer triggers Review, so those lines are OK automatically. A status you set yourself (for example Review) is kept.

h: Invoice notes: black text, red and green flags

i.x: Invoices NOTES column: all notes are now black. When the PCS odometer is lower than the invoice ending odometer it says "PCS odometer is lower than the invoice ending odometer" in dark red. Credit lines say "This is a credit invoice" in dark green, or "Credit invoice total is not negative" in dark red if the total is not negative.

h: Add invoice: aligned file name

i.x: Add invoice window: the File name box is now the same width and alignment as Invoice from and Invoice type, with .pdf inside the box.

h: Invoices: drop opens Add invoice

i.x: Invoices: dropping a PDF now opens the Add invoice window straight away (no separate Save file as box). It has a File name box, Invoice from = Auto-detect and Invoice type = Auto-detect. The green check adds it (with the new name); the red X cancels and adds nothing.

h: Invoices: status pop-up closes on second click

i.x: Invoices: clicking the Status pill of a selected row again now closes the pop-up (it used to close and reopen). Selected rows stay highlighted.

h: User accounts list scrolls

i.x: User Management > User accounts: the list now scrolls, so every user can be reached.

h: Invoices: your note shows in Notes

i.x: Invoices: when you write your own note in an invoice line (for example All good), the NOTES column now shows your note instead of the automatic message.
The NOTES column is narrower and sizes itself to the longest note instead of stretching.

h: Invoices: selection stays when picking a status

i.x: Invoices (and Disputes outcome): when several rows are drag-selected and you click the Status (or Outcome) pill, the rows now stay highlighted while the dropdown is open and after you choose.

h: User editor: window access follows the tabs

i.x: Edit User Account: the Window access list now shows only the groups for the tabs that are checked (turn Accounting off and the Accounting windows disappear from the list; Admin shows all). The old Imaging group is removed.

h: Invoice total auto-calc and typed inactivation date

i.x: Invoice line window: Total now calculates itself from Amount + Tax (and the other charge fields) as you type. You can still type over the Total manually; editing Amount or Tax again recalculates it.
Inactivate truck/trailer: the date is a plain typed box already filled with today (MM/DD/YYYY, slashes added automatically) instead of the calendar picker.

h: Print preview: no more flicker

i.x: Print preview no longer jumps between zoom values (82% / 84%) or turns blurry on long reports. The zoom now settles once and stays; Fit works as before.

h: Print preview looks like the paper page

i.x: Print preview now shows the report on a real page with proper margins (like the print window), instead of edge to edge and zoomed in. Applies to the toll report, other report prints and form prints; scroll, zoom and select still work, and Print… prints it the same way.

h: Toll: copy picture style, clean IDs, print

i.x: Toll Reports (AAA Lease): the navy header with red total now appears only on Copy picture. Print and the print preview use the plain classic look.
Transponder ID no longer shows plate entries such as IN-3223823 or FL-DF22LW, only the transponder numbers.
The real Print… now prints exactly what the preview shows (it was printing the old generic Toll Reports table with TRUCK / FEES columns).

h: Print: no app window in the printout

i.x: The Print… button in the preview now prints only the report itself (it used to send the whole app window, including the blue title bar, to the printer). Applies to every print preview in the app.

h: Toll reports: AAA Lease, preview, Excel

i.x: Toll Reports: removed This month; added an AAA Lease button that shows only Dilmurod Aka and Shorustam trucks. In that mode Copy table, Copy picture and Print use your October layout (Unit Number, Transponder ID, VIN Number, Plate, Total Billed Amount, red total).
Print now opens the in-app preview (zoom, select) with an Excel button that downloads a Summary + Detailed Breakdown workbook like your October file, without the green number-as-text flags.
The same preview now opens for all other print buttons in the app that used to jump straight to the system dialog.

h: Owner trucks as responsible parties

Party list, and a new work order for one of those units picks the owner automatically (you can still change it). Totals by Resp. party in Maintenance Reports, the bottom bar and the print/copy show them in capitals with their own line, only when money was spent. Truck owners (Ryder/Penske) are unchanged.

h: Print preview: zoom and select

h: Totals bar: drivers combined

h: Print and copy: drivers merged

h: Driver name in the Resp. party column

h: Driver names in the maintenance report

Totals by Resp. party (screen, copy picture and the generated report) now list the driver names instead of the word Driver. Two drivers show together on one line, and a driver half of a split counts under that driver. The separate split section is gone.
TBA is hidden from the printed totals, the picture and the generated report, but still counted in your data.
Resp. party is shown in capital letters in the list and in the report.

h: Refresh button on Invoice and Toll reports

i.x: Invoice Reports and Toll Reports now have a green Refresh button right before the printer, the same as the Maintenance Report.

h: Work order header uses less space

i.x: Work order header: Resp. Party now sits right under Odometer and the Driver box right under Driver Type, so the two share one row and the form is one row shorter.

h: Driver picked automatically from the description

Custom Split: Driver and Driver - choose a name are now one option called Driver, with a box to type or pick the name. When you open it, the names from the description are already filled in.

h: Splits no longer saved in the list

i.x: Resp. Party list: a 50/50 or custom split you set on one work order no longer shows up as an option on new work orders. Only your own custom parties (like a warranty company) are kept in the list. A work order that has a split still shows it.

h: Quick add driver to HR from the split

i.x: Custom Split: if the driver name you type is not in HR, an Add to HR button appears. It opens a small window (first name, last name, role); the driver is created and filled into the split right away.

h: Readable split names in the report table

i.x: Maintenance Reports table: the Resp. party column now shows split work orders as IZZY LEE / WADE WALKER instead of the long 50/50: Driver (...) + Driver (...) text. Percent and amount splits show the split after the names.

h: Work order driver split: type a name

i.x: Custom Split: after choosing Driver, you can now type the driver's name or pick one from the list (it suggests as you type).
The Driver — choose a name option now sits right below Driver in the party list.
Maintenance Report: a split between two drivers now shows both full names, for example IZZY LEE / WADE WALKER, with what each one pays.

h: Smooth list scrolling, equal Home boxes

i.x: Moving down or up a list with the arrow keys now scrolls smoothly. The grid no longer jumps back and forth or stutters when the selection reaches the bottom or top.
Home page: Company Details and Contact Information now share the height equally with Company Documents and Tax Exempt Forms, so nothing is squished.

h: Scroll follows the arrow keys

i.x: When you move the selection with the Up and Down keys, the list now scrolls along so the selected row is always in view, in every list of the app.
New Jersey ST-4: the exempt purpose box is filled in with the trucking exemption text (N.J.S.A. 54:32B-8.43) and the statute number line is filled with 8.43. Neither has an edit box.

h: Tax forms: only what changes

i.x: The fill-in window for tax exempt forms now shows only the boxes you actually change: vendor / shop name, date and the seller address. Company details (EIN, address, name, title and so on) stay filled in automatically and no longer get a box.

New Jersey ST-4: the EIN goes in the Eligible Nonregistered Purchaser box, the New Jersey registration number is left empty, and the seller name and address lines are no longer filled with Westmore's address.

h: Keyboard navigation

i.x: In any list (truck services, work orders, drivers, citations, inspections, tax forms and more) the Up and Down arrows move the selected row, Home and End jump to the first and last, and Enter opens the selected row like a double-click.
Escape closes the active window (it still asks first if there are unsaved changes).
Ctrl+A on a tax exempt form no longer paints the whole form dark blue, and Escape clears any highlight.

h: Tax forms open in a movable window

i.x: Tax exempt forms and the Generate screen now open as normal app windows: drag them, minimize them, resize them, with the same colors as the rest of the app.
The delete confirmation for a tax exempt form now appears in front of the form instead of behind it.

h: Every fillable form fills itself

i.x: Tax exempt forms with fillable fields now match every field by name: company, address, city, state, ZIP, EIN, USDOT, MC, phone, email, IRP, IFTA, dates, signer name and title. Fields the app does not recognise get their own box in Generate, and Claude looks for them in your whole app and remembers the answer.

h: Westmore IRP number remembered

i.x: The Westmore IRP account number (456957) is now filled automatically on tax exempt forms that ask for it, and it is used if there is no IRP document in Company Documents.

h: Fillable forms: IRP, IFTA and vehicles

i.x: Generate on fillable forms (like Utah TC-719) now shows Purchase / lease date (today), IRP and IFTA account numbers, dealer number, seller address, and a Vehicles section: choose a truck or trailer and its VIN, year, make and model fill in (up to the number of rows on the form).
IFTA and IRP numbers are read from your Company Documents. Anything else still empty is looked up in your whole app by Claude, and remembered for next time. Redeploy worker.js.

h: One PDF with many units

i.x: Truck and Trailer Services: drop one PDF that holds several cab cards or DOT inspections. It is split page by page into one file per unit, each matched to its truck or trailer and read for dates. Scanned PDFs can be split by Claude AI (it asks first). Redeploy worker.js for the AI split.

h: Rename uploaded files

i.x: A Rename button (pencil) on every uploaded file in Files & Media for trucks, trailers, work orders, citations, inspections, drivers, and a pencil on the company document file box. The file type (.pdf) is kept.

h: Unsaved changes warning on trucks

i.x: Truck and trailer windows now warn "Unsaved Changes" if you changed a date or any field and close with the X without saving.

h: Drag selects only the range

i.x: Company Documents and Tax Exempt Forms: dragging to select now covers only the rows between where you started and where the mouse is. Moving back up or down unselects the rows you moved away from.

h: New click replaces the selection

i.x: Company Documents and Tax Exempt Forms: after selecting several rows, clicking a row that is not selected now unselects the old ones and selects only that row.

h: No false unsaved warning

i.x: Company Documents: opening a document and closing it without typing no longer asks about unsaved changes.

h: Click a selected row to clear all

i.x: Company Documents and Tax Exempt Forms: clicking a selected row now unselects the whole selection instead of only that one row. Dragging over selected rows still unselects just those.

h: Cleaner document and form rows

i.x: A blue "N selected" tag appears after the search box when rows are selected, with a small x to clear.
The delete button only appears on a selected row. Rows light up with a blue edge when you hover.
The Generate button was removed from the tax exempt form rows. Double-click a form to open it and press Generate there.
Selecting in one box clears the selection in the other.

h: Select rows, double-click to open

i.x: Company Documents and Tax Exempt Forms: one click selects a row in blue (click again to unselect) and drag over rows to select several. Double-click opens it.
Edit document: once a file is attached the Cloud AI upload box is hidden, and the remove (X) button is red.

h: Before / after pictures restored

i.x: What's new shows the Before and After pictures again for the last updates (1.0.536 to 1.0.541), which had been left out.

h: Tax forms open for coworkers

i.x: A tax exempt form uploaded on another computer now opens for coworkers right away instead of saying the file is not available. The app fetches it from the cloud when needed.
The Fill empty lines with AI button was removed from the tax form window.

h: Any address format

h: Driver license on forms

i.x: The owner's CDL number and state (NY) are filled automatically on the forms that ask for a driver license, without AI.

h: Minnesota and North Carolina IDs

Tax ID number and its state of issue are filled on Minnesota and North Carolina.

h: Tax forms: AI fills from your app

South Carolina now has the seller address split into street, city, state and ZIP.
Checkboxes are ticked on Pennsylvania, Nebraska, Missouri, Minnesota, Michigan and Indiana for interstate trucking, plus the Nebraska category and Minnesota number.

h: EIN then state

h: EIN with state on license lines

h: Older tax forms get the new fields

h: Tax forms: address, phone, EIN

h: Tax forms: cleaner filling

i.x: Shop name and date are now written at the left of the line with a small gap, in the same font as the pre-filled text.
Generate also shows the other empty lines (seller address, license number with your EIN) so you can edit them.
